svg.text: DB Deploy and Rollback – Visual Guide
SQL · S12 · Expand/contract — additive first; rollback is a first-class script
Add Amount, backfill, switch the app, drop Amt later.
A nullable add rolls back. A live rename does not.
DEV → QA → Prod with the app. Practice the rollback in QA.
sp_rename of a live column in one shot breaks the app.

svg.text: ADD Amount NULL, backfill from Amt, drop Amt next release.
SET Amount = Amt WHERE Amount IS NULL;
-- ALTER TABLE dbo.Orders DROP COLUMN Amt;
Additive first; rollback script stored with the migration.
An EF migration is still expand/contract, not a sneaky rename.
